scene: The electric flamingo zaps your glove, illuminating a hidden basement trapdoor.
picture: Flat side-view across the workshop floor. On the far left, a rusted grey breaker box clings to the wall. At the centre sits a yellow tool cart with rubber tongs. The player in his orange jacket and knitted beanie stands right, recoiling slightly from the now-buzzing flamingo beside a newly revealed floor trapdoor.
shown: A circular iron trapdoor handle flush with the floor, on the right.
Insulated black tongs resting on a yellow tool cart, at the centre.
A rusted wall breaker box with switches thrown, on the far left.
